prompt: Get client cl[i]'s deque `q` from `m`, creating a new ArrayDeque if absent. One computeIfAbsent statement. (computeIfAbsent variant)
answer: Deque<Integer> q = m.computeIfAbsent(cl[i], k -> new ArrayDeque<>());
why: computeIfAbsent creates the deque on first use and returns it in one statement.
